_comment: Deploy.ps1 settings for the integration test VM. Copy to settings.json and update values. Full reference: docs/Installation.md#settings-reference
_comment1: Windows service name to create. Default WebJEA.
_comment2: Every host name the site answers on; the certificate must cover all of them.
_comment3: Account the service runs as (scripts execute as this account). gMSA recommended (trailing $). For a regular account, set Deployment.ServicePasswordSecretName in config.json; it is passed as -ServicePassword.
_comment5: HTTP listener port, or 0 to disable. Redirects to HTTPS automatically when HttpsPort is also set.
_comment6: HTTPS listener port, or 0 to disable. Requires CertSubject or CertPath (exactly one).
_comment7: Store mode (config.json Deployment.CertMode = Store): subject of the LocalMachine\My certificate. The test run creates a self-signed one if none matches; Deploy.ps1 warns that it is untrusted, which is expected.
_comment7a: File mode (Deployment.CertMode = File): set this to e.g. C:\webjea\tls\webjea.pfx and empty CertSubject. The test run exports a fresh self-signed PFX there each time.
_comment8: Folder the release's site files are copied to.
_comment9: Folder for WebJEA scripts and webjea.json. Starter scripts are copied only if it has no webjea.json (or legacy config.json), and never overwrite existing files.
_comment10: Folder for the application and usage logs.
_comment11: Application log file name, in LogPath.
_comment12: Simplified usage log file name, in LogPath (importable into Excel).
